_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 73.4% analog and converging risk-on factors argue for eventual upward resolution to Hope, but with 97% of recent 12h windows holding ±2 points and fed_liquidity pinned at 0, the coil has not broken — HOLD is the statistically honest call until the breaker fires.
next_move.brains_agree: Both agree on UP direction to Hope, but split on timing — analyst demands confirmation signals first, narrative implies continuation is already pricing in
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity breaks above 20 with btc_momentum_30d holding above 60 and fear_greed pushing past 65
next_move.invalidated_if: fed_liquidity stays pinned at 0 while vix spikes above 75 and funding flips negative, indicating risk-off repricing despite surface calm
